business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides property management, value-added services to non-property owners, and community value-added services in Chinese Mainland.
business_overview.revenue_model: Property management fees and related value-added service fees, mainly generated from projects in Chinese Mainland.
business_notes: Revenue from Leading Holdings Group contributed RMB73.427 million, 11.1% of 2025 revenue.
The group has one operating and reportable segment; all revenue from external customers is derived from Chinese Mainland operations.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Interest from cash and bank balances; excluded from owner-earnback operating profit when cash principal is treated as detachable.
Incentives without specific conditions; not treated as core recurring owner earnings.

non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of profit or loss

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Credit loss on property management receivables; treated as recurring cash quality pressure rather than fully added back.

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash at banks and on hand; deposited with creditworthy banks; includes restricted cash RMB2k and pledged deposits RMB100k.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, note 20 Cash and cash equivalents

funds_assets.business_substance: Restricted cash excluded from detachable funds.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, note 20 Cash and cash equivalents

funds_assets.business_substance: Pledged deposits excluded from detachable funds.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, note 20 Cash and cash equivalents

operating_assets.business_substance: Receivables from property management and value-added services, net of RMB78.604m allowance.
Trade-related balances with controlling shareholder companies and related parties, net of impairment.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, note 28 Related party transactions

operating_assets.business_substance: Prepayments, deposits, utility prepayments on behalf of customers and other receivables.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, note 19 Prepayments and other receivables

investment_assets.business_substance: Unlisted equity investment in a private entity engaged in banking business; not treated as detachable cash.
investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, note 16 Equity investments designated at FVOCI

investment_assets.business_substance: Property management joint venture interests accounted for by equity method.
investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, note 15 Investments in joint ventures

other_assets.item: Property, plant and equipment, goodwill, intangibles, deferred tax assets and inventories
other_assets.business_substance: Operating and accounting assets not treated as funds assets.
other_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of financial position

financing_liabilities.business_substance: No interest-bearing borrowings as at 31 December 2025.
financing_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, Management Discussion and Analysis, current ratio and gearing ratio

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Non-interest-bearing trade payables normally settled on 90-day terms.
Advance receipts from property management service contracts; retained as operating obligation in owner-earnback analysis.

operating_liabilities.item: Receipts on behalf of customers for utilities
operating_liabilities.business_substance: Customer utility collections included in other payables; excluded from detachable funds.
operating_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, note 22 Other payables and accruals

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Unsecured, non-interest-bearing and repayable on demand related party balances.
operating_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, note 28 Related party transactions

other_liabilities.item: Tax payable and deferred tax liabilities
other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of financial position

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year operating cash flow exceeds parent net profit on median figures and capex is light, but 2023 cash flow was inflated by a large related-party receivable release and 2025 receivable impairment increased sharply.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2025, note 20 Cash and cash equivalents
Annual Report 2025, Management Discussion and Analysis
evidence.note: Gearing ratio not meaningful because interest-bearing borrowings were nil.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of cash flows

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by parent company, offshore listing vehicle and PRC operating subsidiaries.
No detailed maturity ladder for bank deposits beyond the cash-equivalent accounting policy was found.
Maintenance capex is not disclosed separately from total purchases of property, plant, equipment and intangibles.
